title: Isao prints the base in play: a bare story page grows from the landing to the finished base
context: Owner: 'Isao keeps building stuff, all the elements we have.' A bare index.html was the story at stage 1 and dead-ended: no gate, so no fodder, so no handover (QA 2026-09-16: the optic handed over at 31 s, then nothing until 110 s, NO TARGET · WAVE 0). Design: section A of the 2026-09-16 base-growth investigation notes; QA stage-4 timings (Rotor ready 29.8 s, cleared 70.6 s, settled 93.7 s) set the budget.
outcome: planBase(planet, layout, stage, { reach }) marks later islands, structures, the gate and walls pending; the default output is byte-identical (sha256 of the plan JSON at stages 0-8 unchanged on the Node test planet and the baked planet); a pending rocket opens no ground; until still reads the current stage, so a grown base keeps the intact SH02. src/fx/story-base.js: pending pieces stand at zero scale or hidden and rise with growIsland/growWall/grow/growGate (remembered for a model still loading); gate().built, no hydraulics before; a hidden landmark never fetches its near tier. src/content/base-programme.js + src/domain/build-programme.js: eight steps in order, one at a time (gate and walls at rotor-ready, landing pad, Stalheart at breach, solar at expedition -> station, bays in sector 1 idle -> hulls, HUGIN in sector 1 idle -> gunship meter x1.5, radar at sector 2 -> uplink, assembly in sector 2 idle -> rebuild one lost hull per new sector); steps already standing carry their perks, so a static stage-8 base has them all. src/fx/base-print.js maps a step onto the planet (the cell Isao flies to, the bed his beam rasters, the pieces rising; the gate is built only when its walls stand). story-world: grow for grow=1 and for a story page naming no stage (stage=N stays static); the beats hold rotor-ready until the gate is built, then keep the tremor delay; berths stay the invisible camp until the bays are printed; the solar array's pad (story.arrayPad.standing) is false while the solar complex is pending and set by the station perk. td-tab: structure orders placed by storyApi.build() only when no order waits unclaimed, Isao's line as each starts (never over a manned seat or another line), seconds and bed on the order, storyApi.printed turns the walls to rock in dungeon.tags and tdFullTags and adopts the bays, storyApi.perks()/hasPerk(name) for the laser, shield and gunship; the site ring moved to src/fx/site-ring.js and adoptBays extracted (td-tab net -26 lines). The nav Story entry and the ROTOR jump grow too.
alternatives: Start the V1 entry at stage 4 or later so the tutorial has a gate; rejected: the owner asked for the base to grow in play.
Print the landing slab before the gate (the notes' order); changed to the gate first, so the wait between the Rotor and the tremor is one 12 s print with no trip (QA budget: tremor by 45-60 s).

Start the Stalheart at 'cleared' (the notes); moved to 'breach' because the handover at 'settled' comes about 23 s after 'cleared' at stage 4, shorter than the print plus the trip, while Isao sits idle for about 25 s during the approach.
Block the walls as they rise one by one; rejected: the walls and the gate turn to rock together when the step stands, so no half-built rim leaks the swarm.
evidence: node test/base-plan.mjs (reach = stage byte-identical at 0-8, the non-pending subset of a grown plan is the static plan); the plan hash script before/after identical at stages 0-8 on both planets.
test/build-programme.mjs (content coverage of every pending piece, order, gates, standing perks, one rebuild per sector); test/story-beats.mjs (the tremor waits for the gate, then its delay).
npm test and npm run check green at each commit (112 test programs after the v1-loop merge).

Browser --grow on c0fe9b3 (headless, lock slot 1): PASS grow-bare, grow-landing, grow-gate-printing, grow-tremor, grow-stalheart-rising, grow-fodder, grow-settled, grow-study, grow-solar-rising, grow-bays, grow-hugin. Timings from stage=1&grow=1: Rotor printed 25.9 s, gate print begins 25.9 s, gate stands 38.6 s, tremor 40.1 s, landing pad 48.2 s, override 72.8 s, first wave cleared 80.4 s, Quiver optic 84.9 s, settled (handover) 99.9 s, study 112.5 s, expedition 112.7 s, solar 134.7 s, bays 160.6 s, HUGIN 190.4 s, radar and assembly 233.3 s. The last assertion compared perks in earned order instead of as a set; fixed in 8fb8f88 and re-run: all 12 steps PASS including grow-finished (every step printed in order, all seven perks, a lost hull rebuilt at the next sector start), handover at 100.0 s, radar and assembly at 233.4 s.
Browser --story-world and --defense on c0fe9b3: every step PASS (explicit stage=N stays static).
